# What Your Sessions Murmur

> A live, read-only view of what this machine's cells murmured into the
> quests' webs over the last day: each murmur's words, the cell that said
> it, the quests it is tied to, and how it was settled.

- [The page](index.html): the murmurs drawn as a flock at dusk over a
  wire, then listed newest first, walked by keyboard or pointer.
- [The page as text](index.md): how to read it, the keys, and what the
  data holds.
- The data: the mycelium node's `murmur` records, which the page watches
  live over the sites' server at /feed/node. An agent on the machine runs
  `mycelium web <quest>` itself, to say, tie, settle or fold.
- [The map](../mycelium/): every cell and the networks they share.
- [All his sites](../llms.txt): the home this page sits in.
